acceptedAnswer.text: Miami Beach condo sellers need a building-specific plan that considers beach access, view, building condition, amenities, fees, assessments, rental policies, and comparable sales. Kelby Contreras helps sellers prepare, price, market, negotiate, and coordinate Miami Beach condo transactions.
